self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: Plunging Attack CRIT Rate +16/24/32% (R1/R3/R5). Unconditional, so it is auto-applied (no admin toggle) at the leaderboard's chosen refinement for this weapon. Lived in self_modifiers_json at its R5 value until 2026-09-26, when gacha 4* weapons got R1/R3/R5 tiers.

R5 The Weight of Falling Branches: after a Plunging Attack hits an opponent, Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attack DMG is increased by 32% for 10s. refinementStates carries R1/R3/R5 (R2/R4 read R1/R3); `states` stays the R5 tier.

en.flavor: Bold Burkina from the Scions of the Canopy once made this weapon with the hero Tenoch's help — all for the sake of obtaining Flamegranates unmatched throughout Natlan.

fr.flavor: Le courageux Burkina des Êtres des canopées a autrefois construit cette arme avec l'aide du héros Tenoch... Tout cela dans le but d'obtenir des flamboigrenades sans égal dans tout Natlan.
